title: Virtual Care Fee Schedule: Cancellation Notice, Late Cancellation and No-Show
content:
Five attendance figures apply to each Virtual Care visit type: the cancellation notice in hours, the late cancellation fee, the no-show fee, whether the first virtual no-show in 12 months is waived, and the join grace period in minutes.

## Definitions

- **Cancellation notice** — the number of hours before a scheduled start by which a patient cancellation is timely.
- **Late cancellation fee** — the fee, in US dollars, for a late patient cancellation of a scheduled virtual visit.
- **No-show fee** — the fee, in US dollars, for a scheduled virtual visit the patient does not join.
- **First no-show waived** — whether the first virtual no-show in 12 months is waived (yes or no).
- **Join grace period** — the number of minutes after the scheduled start within which the patient may still join.

## Fee schedule

| Visit type | Cancellation notice | Late cancellation fee | No-show fee | First no-show waived | Join grace period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | 0 hours | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | 0 minutes |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | 4 hours | $0.00 | $15.00 | Yes | 10 minutes |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 4 hours | $15.00 | $25.00 | Yes | 10 minutes |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 24 hours | $40.00 | $60.00 | No | 15 minutes |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 24 hours | $25.00 | $40.00 | Yes | 10 minutes |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 0 hours | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | 5 minutes |

## Reading the schedule

- **Visit types with a figure of $0.00.** The Portal E-Visit and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care carry $0.00 for both fees. The Audio-Only Phone Visit carries a $0.00 late cancellation fee and a $15.00 no-show fee.
- **The first-no-show setting.** The Behavioral Health Video Visit is the one visit type whose first-no-show setting is No.
- **Notice periods.** The Audio-Only Phone Visit and the Primary Care Video Visit carry a notice of 4 hours; the Behavioral Health Video Visit and the Specialty Video Follow-Up carry a notice of 24 hours.

## Comparison by visit type

**Which visit type carries the largest no-show fee?** The Behavioral Health Video Visit, at $60.00, followed by the Specialty Video Follow-Up at $40.00, the Primary Care Video Visit at $25.00 and the Audio-Only Phone Visit at $15.00.

**How long may a patient still join a Behavioral Health Video Visit after its scheduled start?** Up to 15 minutes, the longest join grace period of any visit type; the On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care period is 5 minutes and the Audio-Only Phone Visit, Primary Care Video Visit and Specialty Video Follow-Up periods are 10 minutes.
